I told Hollis in a thread reply in #central-team that the site for the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is Gate 47. I flagged that Dock 23 is wrong so it doesn't go on the account sheet.

The answer comes from the gbrain record of Pree's own correction. On Oct 14 she first posted Dock 23 in #central-team, then corrected it to Gate 47 because she had read the wrong line. Both messages were in #central-team, where Hollis was asking, so the answer only uses what he could already see there.
